qualification: Two agent visual passes, not independent human gold labels. Reviewed-view results are privileged diagnostics. Public video groups are held out, athlete identities are not proven disjoint.

report.qualification: Video-group held-out research evaluation with two agent visual passes; oracle view is privileged diagnostic input, not app accuracy
report.clipPolicy: Mean hand scores once per source frame then mean unique source frames for raw choice. Accepted label requires agreeing predictions at >=.8 grip and >=.8 contact on two distinct source times; any conflicting accepted label remains unknown. No reference window/contact label gates clip inference.

audit.counterfactualQualification: Same 17 neutral RGB crops with artificially forced view inputs; sensitivity diagnostic, not accuracy on those viewpoints.

preTestFreeze.qualification: Paired models, source roles, crops and detector frozen before any new test source image opened; joint initial trial preserved as validation-only failure

binary.architecture: Shared directly supervised surface CNN, independently fitted contact head, conditional RGB-embedding+surface head; grip cannot change surface CNN

threeway.architecture: Shared directly supervised surface CNN, independently fitted contact head, conditional RGB-embedding+surface head; grip cannot change surface CNN
